method: Inert UTF-8 text searches and bounded source-span inspection; parser imports unavailable. Locally assigned RG-* IDs are supplemental, not REA Evidence IDs. Existing REA/artifact reports reused.
offsetConvention: Zero-based decoded UTF-16 char offsets and original UTF-8 byte offsets; ranges are contextual spans, not AST node ranges.
reaUsageLimit: Static JS analyzer available. No new whole 8.68MB UI graph requested because operation has no focused-file/subtree semantics seed without producing a parent graph; inspected exact static text instead. Existing launcher REA graph is not game UI evidence.

anchors.title: Top-level routes
anchors.observation: 21 route declarations including blank root; flat route table under common window/overlay/model wrappers.

anchors.title: Overlay layer
anchors.observation: overlay event drives nine named overlay components; overlays are independent of pathname.

anchors.title: Settings schema and renderer
anchors.observation: 20 type enum values; base renderer handles seven controls plus recursive category; game map adds keybind/color.

anchors.title: Checkbox and toggle serialization
anchors.observation: Update booleans as true/false strings; checked display uses option.value.

anchors.title: Dropdown/text/multiple numbers
anchors.observation: choices have name/id; text forwards string; multi_number parses JSON array, float conversion and NaN to zero.

anchors.title: Radio defaults
anchors.observation: choices contain id/name/description; passes default and hideRecommended.

anchors.title: Slider rounding and bounds
anchors.observation: Pointer clamps range and rounds by step; manual input parses numeric text, rounds and honors forceMin/forceMax; wrapper defaults both flags true and passes roundTo as step.

anchors.title: Dynamic settings state
anchors.observation: Initial general/performance/controls/rewind arrays and features map empty; host payload supplies trees; option:update recursively replaces by id; invalid id/scope raises error.

anchors.title: Settings scope/navigation/search
anchors.observation: Scopes GENERAL/PERFORMANCE/CONTROLS/REWIND/FEATURE; recursive options; category selection, whitelist, text/id/description/badge search and ADVANCED filter.

anchors.title: Keybind editor
anchors.observation: Displays modifier/key value and conflicts; onEdit switches host keybind capture; clash policy supplied as ignoreClashing/clashesWith.

anchors.title: Color editor
anchors.observation: HSB/alpha/chroma updates JSON, favorites provider, pickedColor host event, capture mode, copy/paste base64(JSON), randomization.

anchors.title: Settings host API
anchors.observation: setAdvancedMode,update,reset,invokeAction,setEditingKeybind,stopEditingKeybind delegate to settings namespace.

anchors.title: Mod payload and HUD route
anchors.observation: fi0 filters enabled && allowed mods; rc0 maps only fps to tc0 in examined route.

anchors.title: FPS HUD metadata
anchors.observation: Requests hudModProperty and hudModMetadata for fps; styles with x/y/position and displays fps plus debug-style position/scale labels.

anchors.title: Texture-ready protocol
anchors.observation: gameTexture event id/ready controls rendering of id.imgsrc in img element, default Y flip.

anchors.title: Model lifetime and batching
anchors.observation: add/update/remove queued and JSON serialized after 16ms; keyed by model id with duplicate suppression.

anchors.title: Model layout and hover
anchors.observation: Sends props plus DOM width/height and default zoom 1; ResizeObserver; hover x/y serialization; cleanup removes model.

anchors.title: Waypoint host namespaces
anchors.observation: Waypoint group, import/export, map, mod-import, sort, utility and main waypoints API wrappers.

anchors.title: Waypoint navigator
anchors.observation: Server/group/dimension/death filters, count aggregation, add/edit/delete/group/import flows; confirmDelete value consulted, host decides map availability.

anchors.title: Waypoint editor fields and validation
anchors.observation: Name, group, location/world/dimension, display options and color; current location; numeric coercion; requires nonempty name and color before save.

anchors.title: Waypoint group editor
anchors.observation: Nonblank trimmed name guard; group display override, text/beam/highlight/distance/color/icon; host create/update calls.

anchors.title: Rewind controller namespaces
anchors.observation: Create/validate/rename, media, property/keyframe, timeline, export/queue and playback/layout wrappers.

anchors.title: Rewind editor
anchors.observation: Host playhead/quickView/rendering/progress payload; timeline selection; preview/editor layout, zoom, render region and input focus.

anchors.title: Rewind effects
anchors.observation: Text/image effects selected by id; DOM bounding boxes sent to host; property update batch around selected timeline layer.

anchors.title: Rewind library
anchors.observation: Library filters compatible/all/project/rewind, search name/location, missing-mod confirmation, quick view/open/rename/delete/file location.

anchors.title: Locker tabs

anchors.title: Server discovery
anchors.observation: Server discovery/search/autocomplete/details/join/save/not-interested and ping result callbacks.

anchors.title: Shader cloak editor

anchors.title: Screenshot upload
anchors.observation: Title + public/unlisted/private privacy, default unlisted; route payload JSON passed to host upload; uploading state.

anchors.title: Spirit Leap
anchors.observation: Player/class/dead-state list and host map texture/region; player/map action, default view, settings and close delegates.

anchors.title: Window state and overlay context
anchors.observation: Window state width/height/x/y/fullscreen/shown, sort state and local stacking; host persistence callbacks available.

anchors.title: Specialized Rewind property controls
anchors.observation: Property renderer adds players,packs,date,button controls; keyframe navigation/reset/visibility; multi-number vectors and pose fields; special renderIn/renderOut text commit.

anchors.title: Emote wheel
anchors.observation: Owned/equipped emotes and jams subscribed; radial selection provider.

anchors.title: Spray wheel
anchors.observation: Owned/equipped sprays feed wheel; tutorial describes drag/double-click equip and in-game wheel selection.

anchors.title: Marker wheel
anchors.observation: Host flags list populates radial markers; click marks and closes screen, cleanup clears current marker.

anchors.title: Home menu
anchors.observation: Host buttons/themes/additions/social/promotions feed menu; click delegates to host; wrapped flag changes presentation.

anchors.title: Server host calls
anchors.observation: joinServer forwards recommendationId/serverMappingsId/name/primaryAddress; saveServer name/address; ping result event and timeout 8000ms.

anchors.title: Language selector
anchors.observation: Host available/default/active languages; search, reset, forceUnicode toggle; selected language committed on unmount.

anchors.title: Screenshot title/privacy form
anchors.observation: Title maxCharacters32; privacy enum public/unlisted/private; upload payload received from route state.

anchors.title: Social namespace contracts
anchors.observation: Friends privacy/request/pin/join, hosted-world invite/kick/promote/demote, conversations commands declared; no live service observation.
